exactSavedBalance.arithmetic: Exact Fraction over stored numerical quantities; displayed vertex Euclidean norms use Decimal. Error bounds on cable work remain separately audited.
exactSavedBalance.definitions: g=sum(saved membrane,bending,contact,cable gradients); e=m*(v1-v0)+h*g; delta=(q1-q0)-h*v1; accumulated velocity defect += e/m; accumulated position defect += h*accumulated velocity defect + delta.
exactSavedBalance.energy: A=0.5*sum(m*|v1-v0|^2); W=sum(recorded potential motion work); R=W-g dot (q1-q0); deltaK+W=R+g dot delta+e dot v1-A.
exactSavedBalance.limitation: These identities hold numerical force history fixed. They are neither bounds on a counterfactual trajectory with force feedback nor certificates of constitutive force accuracy, calibrated damping or temporal convergence.

finding: Tightening the force criterion reduces conditional accumulated balance defects, while the dominant early 128-versus-512 native-velocity difference remains about 5.954 mm/s. This observation does not establish causality or temporal convergence.

implementation.capturedJournalPolicy: Strict requests reject AttemptJournal and subclasses before activity because its existing capture/replay schema declares 1e-6 N. Entrypoints unchanged; synthetic declared research journal only.
implementation.criterion: Optional original binary64 scalar, 0 < stationarity_tolerance_newtons <= 1e-6 N; default remains 1e-6 N. Nondefault requests require guarded direct search.
implementation.precisionPolicy: Response/work precision and all arithmetic budgets remain explicit and unchanged; impossible requested accuracy may reject without relaxation.
implementation.propagation: Direct stopping and final reports, fixed/varying cable enclosures, adaptive acceptance/retries, final post-work publication, controlled folds and gripper momentum bounds.
implementation.rawPrecision: Validate raw top/nested criteria before diagnostic conversion; exact rational bound comparison retains positive subnormal contributions.
implementation.trustBoundary: Conditional on trusted non-cable force/work terms. Coherent forged non-cable equilibrium reports and constitutive accuracy are not certified.

scope: Independent standard-library Fraction calculations from saved states and force components; no primary reducer or mechanics imports.
Exact squared vector norms with Decimal180 square roots for displayed values; all saved comparison samples and global witnesses checked.
Native velocities retain their own timestep meaning; common-window secants use identical original-time endpoints with no interpolation or alignment.
Conditional balance uses recorded numerical forces and work; it does not certify their accuracy or bound a counterfactual force-feedback trajectory.
Same-grid stopping sensitivity is smaller in these retained runs; no temporal convergence or causal explanation is established.

findings: No actual input confound: same-grid inputs differ only in profile and explicit criterion.
Driver and adapted auditor reconstruct input identity from older unseparated fixtures; this review additionally binds actual separated same-grid baselines.
The driver retains stale GRIDS=(64,128) only for older fixture checks; requested CLI grids and saved subdivisions are 128/512.
Fixed precision and n512 attempt budget have not been enlarged. Insufficient accuracy or any required retry can still exhaust the run.
The saved force recomputation allowance 2e-10 N is not the stopping threshold and does not certify non-cable force accuracy.
Saved-force and energy identities are exact for stored numerical quantities, not counterfactual force-feedback trajectory bounds or calibrated damping.
The adapted saved-state auditor requires successful process receipt/summary; a terminated prefix would need a separate bounded prefix audit before claiming verification.

limitations: Mock fixtures validate orchestration with real fixed/varying cable diagnostics and work but supply their equilibrium claim; gripper-only work is explicitly mocked. No cloth/garment simulation or physical force certification.
Direct-search test is an analytic scalar quadratic, not a motion run. Default comparisons load committed orchestration/search bytes while using current unchanged dependencies with their default API.
Coherently forged non-cable gradient values remain outside the trusted-solver scope; this review checks requested criterion binding, enclosures, mutation ordering and default compatibility.

localArtifactLimitation: Ignored scratch reports, source snapshots, exact saved trajectories and runtime are not in Git. Identities bind local evidence but do not make a fresh clone independently replayable.
nextStep: Resolve early contact/control dynamics and define intended temporal accuracy/dissipative semantics before more grid studies; then spatial accuracy, construction-specific joints, source construction, materials/body validation and full-shirt application acceptance.
pendingBoundaries: Refined capture/main-replay admission and remote GitHub publication remain pending specific authorization. No alternative refined garment motion, push or deployment executed.
physicalInputComparison: Same-grid direct independent comparison removes only profile and the added criterion. Six-run comparison also removes subdivision count; no coordinates, masses, material, schedules, contact, precision or budgets removed.

The fixture was corrected to four subdivisions/attempts and assertions kept in the subtest; no production numerical change.

result.explanation: Three harness assertions wrongly required an exception record on ordinary above-tolerance residual rejection. The first accepted prefix was preserved; no producer acceptance failure.

Two coherent-reduced-error tests replaced already-exact-zero bound records by the same zero record. Acceptance was correct. V3 requires an actually different coherent positive bound below the requested tolerance.
